title: Sword Shaping Ritual
text: Requires one Pure Vessel and four Crystal Pedestals.

Place one offering on each of the four pedestals in any order, then use a melee weapon on the Pure Vessel to start. Offerings are absorbed in sequence; the vessel gradually disintegrates in pale-blue or pale-purple particles and drops the new weapon after eight seconds. The original weapon is consumed; enchantments are not inherited.

The crystallized nail requires a resonance crystal, spiritual crystal, light crystal core and bone. The arcane needle requires an analysis crystal, mana engine, shadow berries and iron ingot. This ritual consumes the whole analysis crystal.
